Second pre-release of 2.2 — **fonts and colours** on the Bookends page.

## New

- **Font per line** (tab *Lines*, selected line): Bookends' font families (UI font, serif, sans-serif …) or any font of your e-reader. Bookbench stores the path on the e-reader, as Bookends does, and uses the copy in the profile for the workbench picture.
- **Format** button: put `[b]`, `[i]`, `[u]` or a colour `[c=#RRGGBB]` around the selected text — that is how part of a line gets its own colour.
- **Colours** of the preset (tab *Preset*): text, symbols, background behind the top and bottom lines.
- **Own colours and ticks** and **markers** for progress bars and for bars inside a line: colours of the read and unread part, ticks, border, tick height and width, border thickness; markers for session start, book opened, bookmarks or today.
- Sleep screen page: without the patch in the profile, its two switches are now hidden instead of greyed out.

Bookends has no text colour per line — colour for the whole preset, or `[c=…]` inside the text.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.2-beta2.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
